correctness.rationale: Every ideal is uniquely (a,b) with 0<=b<=a<=n. Observations preserve four-interval states. Both branch families of every nonconstant query are nonempty and the recurrence is exactly the minimax shattered-tree recurrence; induction proves it for all n. The independent explicit-concept solver agrees through n=16. Adjacent threshold certificates and all 1024 depth-ten paths at n=52 were checked. VC<=2 by two comparable same-row queries, VC>=2 via four witnesses. Finite tests do not substitute for the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The two-row product-of-chains ideal class is a natural minimal constrained two-threshold family. A four-bound normal form gives a general exact O(n^5)-time rank algorithm. Its sharp finite cutoffs expose nontrivial adaptive learning complexity, with VC dimension fixed at two and Littlestone rank tending to infinity; the n=51 versus 52 transition is not forced by information-theoretic cardinality.
